emi:
EMI
EMI is a featureful and accessible item and recipe viewer. It brings many new features, and optimizes for the user experience. Outside of the standard Fabric/Quilt API, EMI requires zero dependencies, and can be launched with the game simply and easily.

 

 

 Runtime JEI Compat
For runtime JEI compat, all you need to do is install JEI alongside EMI and they will work together to share recipes. JEI will be hidden.

 What does EMI bring to the table?

Of course EMI comes with every feature you'd come to expect from the outset, viewing recipes, favoriting items, searching, and the like. But what's new that EMI offers?

 A craftable mode for quickly crafting any recipes you're able to make, usable by toggle or as a config for empty searches
 Recipes can be favorited with items, and also can be used to quickly craft at a button press
 A recipe tree for breaking down the cost of a comple

attributefix:
Attribute Fixer 
 Minecraft uses an attribute system to handle important calculations. It covers everything from armor values, to attack damage, to the maximum health of a mob. This system also introduced attribute caps, which limit how high any value can be. While this usually goes unnoticed, many mods are unknowingly affected by it. This mod significantly increases these caps to allow those mods to work as they were intended. 
 Affected Attributes 
 
 Max Health 
 Follow Range 
 Knockback Resistance 
 Movement Speed 
 Attack Damage 
 Attack Speed 
 Armor  
 Armor Toughness 
 Luck

- Use the keybind (client mod required)

- Use /invsort sort or /invsort sortme in chat (works with vanilla client)

This is an unofficial fork of Charm, made to be used in a modpack.

A vast majority of this mod was written by Svenhjol and others and updated versions were simply not released, all credits go to the original authors. The original mod is licensed MIT, and this fork will stay the same. 

If/when the original author releases Charm on CurseForge for versions that this fork targets, and implements the fixes this fork does, this fork will no longer be updated. 

 Please do not report any issues to the original developer, report them here. 

Differences from Charm:
- Currently targeting 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 Fabric
- Made a few minor tweaks for improved mod compatibility 
- Balanced stackable enchanted book anvil combining
- (Planned): More modded item/block compatibility for certain features (totems, portals, etc.)

- Override entity textures

- Add screen shaking effects

- Modify gravity

- Add new mobCategories

- Use and extend a wind system

- Modify advancements on runtime

- Add MobEffects to Beacons

- And much more!

vehiclefix:
---

VehicleFix fixes a bug/issue with entities that you can ride that has existed since rideable entities were first introduced. These entities are known as "vehicles" internally, hence the name. The bug in question is that they don't take into account the rider's own hitbox when deciding if they can go past a block, leading to situations where players and entities suffocate when the game shouldn't have even let them go past those blocks.

So what I did was make it so the game will now take into account the height of a rider (although not the width, due to the sheer amount of extra jank that would need) when determining the collision of a vehicle. This works with modded vehicles as well!

recipecooldown:
RecipeCooldown

Supports Minecraft 1.16+ with the Fabric/Quilt modloader, designed for server-side and multiplayer environment.

 Purpose
Whenever a player click on an item in the recipe book, it sends a request to the server to find that recipe for you and fills in the appropriate items to the crafting slots.

However, no cool down has been officially implemented by Mojang, meaning a malicious player can spam packets to the server at an excessive rate (Even with just auto-clicker) and effectively lag out the server.

This is a simple Fabric-compatible mod that prevents excessive crafting recipe request from the client to lag out the server.

 This mod doesn't magically speed up your game, it simply prevents an exploit that allows player to spam packets and causing lags on the server 

 Config
By default, the mod will allow the player to request a recipe every 50ms/1 tick.

Notice: This mod is no longer needed in Minecraft 1.21.9 and above. To disable double tap sprint in 1.21.9+, go to Controls and set Sprint Window to 0

 What

Disables double tapping the Forward key to start sprinting. That's it.

No dependencies, works on every Minecraft version where Fabric and NeoForge exist.

 Why

Minecraft has had a dedicated sprint keybind since version 1.7.2. Unless you absolutely need a double tap to sprint function for accessibility purposes, there is no reason to use it over the dedicated sprint keybind, and all it does is cause accidental sprint startups which waste your hunger points.

...Well, that's what I think, at least. So I made this mod for my own sanity. Use it if you want.

Sable Chunk Guard is a small NeoForge patch mod for Sable.

The mod prevents Sable physics and entity collision code from synchronously loading chunks that are not already fully loaded. When a required chunk is missing or still generating, the unsafe physics or collision calculation is skipped for that tick instead of forcing the server
thread to wait.

This reduces the risk of severe 0 TPS freezes, slow chunk stalls, and world exit hangs caused by Sable interacting with unloaded or generating chunks.

Treeliable

 
 
 

 Treeliable is a highly configurable, simple mod that adds balanced tree felling mechanics!

 Dependencies

 YACL is recommended to configure the mod.

 Features

 Chop down entire trees by breaking a single block. By default, trees must have leaves connected to them to be considered a tree, preventing you from accidentally destroying wooden structures.
 The time it takes to chop down a tree scales dynamically based on its size. You can configure this algorithm to be logarithmic or linear to suit your modpack's balance.
 Trees can be configured to break layer-by-layer with customizable delays and exponential speedup, instead of instantly vanishing.
 An on-screen icon lets you know when you're looking at a tree that can be felled. There's also a spiderweb-like breaking animation on the tree layers as you chop.
 The mod calculates and applies tool damage and player food

Canary
An early warning of poison in the mines.

Canary is a mod that detects dangerous behaviors in other mods and provides several diagnostic tools.

 Detected Issues

 BlockState Property Injection
Some mods try to add new BlockState properties to vanilla blocks.
Unfortunately, this is likely to cause block desyncs.

Solutions:
- Use Statement, a library designed to do this safely
- Use a custom block instead, converting between it and the vanilla block as needed

Some mods try to add new synced data entries ( EntityDataAccessor s) to vanilla entity classes.
Doing this is likely to cause inscrutable networking errors, since field order is not stable between clients and the server.

Solutions:
- Use a Data Attachment
- Store values in normal fields, and sync them with custom packets

Just Spawn Me There - Mod for FabricMC

 About
 

This mod rewrites logic behind vanilla respawning system, so players would not spawn on top of buildings.

 How to Use
To set world spawn for everyone, use

 /setworldspawn [pos] 

Where:
 pos - required argument of 3 coordinates. This would be the center of spawn region.
 angle - not required float argument. Determines in which direction you will be looking upon respawn.

To modify spawn radius, use

 /gamerule spawnRadius [value] 

Where:
 value - required argument of non-negative integer. If value is set to 0 , players will respawn at exact location specified by "/setworldspawn" command.

And finally, to select the shape of your spawn region, use

 /gamerule spawnShape [value] 
 value - required string argument with the specified shape. You can choose between CUBE , BALL and VANILLA - this would determine the shape of spawn region wher

Unlike texture-pack based solutions or client-side "anti-cheat" mods, ViperAntiXray operates at the network layer the server sends fake block data for unexposed ores, and only reveals real blocks when players legitimately mine adjacent blocks, trigger explosions, or gain direct line-of-sight.

 Key differentiator: Zero client installation required for per tick packet precisison, to eliminate fake ore discovery even on high ping. Vanilla players connect normally and see legitimate world generation. X-ray users see only stone, deepslate, and configurable fake ores.

---

 Core Anti-Xray Engine (Unmodified)

The heart of ViperAntiXray is a faithful port of Paper's Async Anti-Xray patch the same battle

restrictions:
Restrictions

Restrictions is a simple vanilla styled mod which adds three basic blocks that all have to do with entity movement (items, mobs, players):
- Attractor: this block attracts entities in front of it. It has a range equal to the redstone signal that is given to it so it is deactivated if it has no redstone signal
- Pusher: this block pushes away entities in front of it. Also with a range equal to the strength of the redstone signal
- One Way: this is a transparent block that forces movement of entities in a certain direction. This block needs no redstone signal. This block can be used to transport entities in all directions. You can use it for a fast upwards elevator or to move mobs from a spawner elsewhere

 Modpacks
You can use this mod freely in any modpack.

Double Edged Reforged / 双刃重铸

Double Edged Reforged 是一个面向 Minecraft 1.20.1 与 SlashBlade: Resharped（拔刀剑：重锋）的 Forge 附属模组。

本模组尝试恢复新版拔刀剑中已经移除的双刀流机制，并以独立连招、伤害归属、玩家动画和特殊效果兼容为基础，继续探索三刀流等扩展玩法。

 本项目在设计、编码、移植分析、调试和文档编写过程中大量使用了生成式 AI。作者的 Java 开发经验有限，虽然项目经过了一定程度的实际测试，但无法保证代码质量、稳定性、多人游戏同步或与其他模组的兼容性。

 主要功能

 双刀流

当玩家主手与副手同时持有符合条件的拔刀剑时，进入双刀流模式。

双刀流并非单纯复制一份主手刀光，而是尝试为主手和副手分别维护：

- 当前攻击刀与装备槽位
- 刀光及伤害归属
- 武器属性修饰符
- 附魔效果

启用三刀流后，拔刀剑可以装备在头盔槽，并以刀身模型渲染在玩家嘴部，而不是显示为普通头戴物品模型。

Configurable Zombie AI

Configurable Zombie AI is a mod that makes vanilla zombies easier to tune for harder survival servers and modpacks.

Instead of hardcoding one zombie behavior profile, the mod exposes runtime commands for server operators so they can change how zombies detect, acquire, keep, and switch targets without restarting the world. Settings are stored with the world and apply to loaded zombies immediately.

 What It Does

 Changes zombie follow range (configurable).
 Optionally lets zombies ignore line of sight checks.
 Optionally prevents zombies from despawning naturally.
 Replaces vanilla "pick the nearest valid target" behavior with configurable target acquisition.
 Optionally lets zombies re-evaluate and switch targets over time using weighted rules.

🚀 Inventory Advancement Accelerator

When a server has a large number of advancements, data packs, or online players, vanilla Minecraft frequently iterates through the relevant advancement conditions. This mod creates a per-player item index and filters only the conditions that may match the current inventory change, while continuing to use Minecraft’s vanilla predicates and reward logic for the final evaluation.

Simply put: fewer unnecessary checks, while preserving vanilla behavior. ⚡

 🚀 Significantly Fewer Candidate Checks

Relevant advancement conditions are located based on the items that actually changed in the player’s inventory, avoiding a full scan of every listener each time.

 🎯 Precise Vanilla Evaluation

Final matching is still performed by Minecraft’s vanilla TriggerInstance , ItemPredicate , and context predicates. The vanilla reward logic is not replaced.

 🧩 Suppor

mob-tag-fixes:
Mob Tag Fixes

A small NeoForge mod that adds modded mobs to the vanilla entity type tags they belong in, so vanilla combat mechanics work on them. Pure data and tags, nothing is patched or mixin'd.

 What it does
A lot of vanilla combat behavior is decided by entity type tags. Smite and the healing and harming effect use minecraft:undead, raids and Bad Omen use minecraft:raiders, and Bane of Arthropods uses the arthropod tag. However, a modded mob is only in those tags if its own mod added it there, and many mods do not, so a modded skeleton takes no extra damage from Smite and is healed by a Potion of Healing, a modded illager is skipped by raids, and Bane of Arthropods does not work on a modded spider.

Mob Tag Fixes adds those mobs to the tags they were left out of. Every entry is soft, so a mod you do not have is skipped instead of causing an error, and the vanilla tags are extended

NoScreenShake

A small utility mod for Minecraft 1.8.9 Forge that disables camera shake effects during view bobbing.
There are many mods that aim to disable viewbobbing screen shake, sadly most of those are either for newer versions or are bundled with many other features.
This mod aims to fix that, it's a lightweight mod that only includes a small, but very useful feature.

 Features

- Disabled the screen and crosshair shaking with viewbobbing to make aiming easier.
- Configurable via a simple in-game toggle with OneConfig.
- Lightweight.

 Installation

1. Make sure you have Minecraft 1.8.9 with Forge installed.
2. Place NoScreenShake-1.8.9-forge-1.0.0.jar in your mods folder.
3. Launch Minecraft.

 Configuration

- Open the in-game config GUI to enable or disable the mod on the fly.
- The toggle controls whether the mod logic is active.

 Contributing
 Pull requests are welcome. For

Whenever a player triggers a normal Totem of Undying, it is replaced with a Broken Totem of Undying .

- The broken totem appears in the same hand where the original was used.

This ensures that every time a Totem of Undying saves you, it leaves behind a relic.
The Broken Totem can then be used to craft a new Totem of Undying .

 

A small, lightweight mod that keeps the Use of the Totem alive even after use!

If you find any issue you can report it here: Issue Tracker

Press H at any time to open the Mini Quests GUI. Within the interface, you’ll find a slot where you can submit a required item. Each quest asks for a single item, often something relatively common or themed around different aspects of the game (like food, ores, or mob drops). Once submitted, the item is consumed, and you instantly receive a random reward item which can range from useful tools, rare resources, enchanted gear, or even decorative surprises.

 json

}

Normally, some mobs get different appearances or variants depending on where they spawn. Biome Summoner gives you control over that directly through commands.

 Commands

Use:

 /summonbiome 

For example:

 /summonbiome minecraft:villager minecraft:snowy plains 

You can also use the extended summon syntax:

 /summon minecraft:villager biome minecraft:snowy plains 

 What Does It Do?

The mod attempts to summon the selected entity using the spawning conditions of the biome you specify.

This means mobs that have biome-dependent variants can use the appearance or variant associated with that biome, even when you aren't actually standing in that biome.

keep-but-penalty:
Keep But Penalty

 Keep your inventory. Pay a fair price for death. 

Keep But Penalty is a lightweight, zero-dependency multi-loader mod for Fabric , Forge , and NeoForge that keeps player inventories on death without mutating the world's keepInventory gamerule—while replacing tedious corpse runs with fair, configurable experience, durability, hunger, and progressive respawn debuff penalties.

 Highlights

- Death-Scoped Keep Inventory : Temporarily projects keepInventory = true via a reentrant ThreadLocal only while ServerPlayer.die and ServerPlayer.restoreFrom execute. Your world's real keepInventory gamerule is never altered.
- Exact Experience Penalty : Defaults to keeping 75% of total experience (25% lost). Computes experienceLevel , experienceProgress , and totalExperience directly with exact vanilla math—never calling giveExperiencePoints , so XP pickup events and Mending are nev

Anti Pie

Anti Pie is a server-side plugin that stops certain hidden block entities from being sent to players. This keeps them from showing up on the debug pie chart, making it harder to use the pie chart to find hidden bases.

 How it works

- Removes selected block entities from chunk packets before they are sent to the client.
- Regularly checks hidden positions and sends the real block and block entity data as soon as they become visible.
- Uses a voxel raycast and counts full solid blocks as blockers. Transparent blocks and partial blocks do not hide a target.

 Performance

Most packets only do a few simple type checks. Visibility checks are limited by visibilityChecksPerPass (32 by default): four times per second while a player is moving and once per second while standing still. When chunks first load, visibility checks are also limited to 64 per player each tick.

This is a small, subjective mod that aims to improve the overall balance of item sorting and transportation.

Fully server-side — players won't need to install anything if you put it on your server. Safe to remove — it won't break worlds. No Fabric API required.

 

 
 My thoughts 

Despite Allay's primary purpose being to deliver items to the player, few people actually used it that way. Instead, players found it more useful for item sorting. Now, however, that job falls to a new mob — Copper Golem — leaving Allay with even fewer reasons to exist. I don't find the companion mob concept particularly compelling, but I do think there's real potential in turning it into a transport mob — an alternative to hopper minecarts. This mod translates Minecraft chat into multiple languages!

 Supported languages:
- English (english/en)
- French (french/fr)
- German (german/de)
- Russian (russian/ru)
- Spanish (spanish/es)

 Example
 

 How select language?

 
/sw4-translator mylanguage spanish/russian/german/french/english
 

 How does the mod translate messages?

Message Interception - The ChatHud.addMessage() mixin intercepts all incoming chat messages.

Text Extraction - Parses the message, separating the player name from the text:

 hello → Player: "Player", text: "hello"

HTTP Request to Google Translate - Sends an asynchronous GET request:

 
https://translate.googleapis.com/translate a/single?client=gtx&sl=auto&tl=ru&dt=t&q=hello
 

sl=auto - autodetect source language

tl=ru - disable language (your selected one)

q=hello - text to translate

JSON Response Parsing - Extracts the translated text from Google'

This mod makes a small change to the way status effects work.

 Default Settings

Normally, consuming a potion (example; 8 minutes of Strength) will set the duration of the effect to 8 minutes, regardless of how many times you drink it, with it being the longest possible within the game.

However, with Additive Statuses installed, these potions will instead add to the total duration of the effect.

 Configuration
Accessing the config file or using Mod Menu, the following can be done: 
 Cycle Amplification
When activated, when the duration of an effect hits an indicated "maximum duration", it will set the duration to an indicated "starting duration", while increasing the amplification of the effect by 1.

Specific effects can be blacklisted from this, by default, effects that aren't changed by amplification (e.x; Night Vision) are on the list.

Addoners Optimizer

Addoners Optimizer is a client-side performance mod for Minecraft 1.26.1.2 (Fabric) that dynamically adjusts selected video settings based on real-time FPS measurements to help maintain smoother and more stable gameplay performance.

 How it works

The mod samples the player's FPS every second using a rolling average and applies one of three optimization levels:

 LOW (≥80 FPS) — minimal adjustments, prioritizing visual quality
 MEDIUM (50–79 FPS) — moderate reductions to selected graphics settings
 AGGRESSIVE (<50 FPS) — stronger reductions intended to improve frame stability on lower performance systems

A 3-second cooldown between changes helps prevent rapid setting fluctuations.

 Features

 Automatically adjusts:

 Render distance
 Particle settings
 Smooth lighting
 Shader quality settings
 Optional status HUD displaying:

 Current FPS
 Active optimization level

Common Signals
 
 
 
 
 
 

📚 Common Signals is a library datapack that provides signals through function tags to help developers optimize their datapacks.

 Available Signals 📡

 Usage for Developers 🔧
1. 📦 Create a datapack that depends on Common Signals
2. ➕ Add functions to the signal tags you want to listen to 
3. ⚡ Your functions will be called whenever those signals are triggered

uglified:
About
The Uglified resource pack is a modified version of Minecraft's default textures to make them look ugly. Every Minecraft texture has been run through a custom script that uglifies the textures.

The script used to create this resource pack is in this GitHub repository: https://github.com/AndEditor7/UglifierScript

If you want to automatically uglify the textures in runtime, including the modded and resource packs, you can use this Minecraft mod here: https://modrinth.com/mod/uglifier

 Why It Exists
There is a phenomenon that occurs when you use terrible textures and then remove them after playing for a while; the Minecraft textures will look clear and crisp. Useful if you need to get readjusted to Minecraft's default texture after playing too much high-definition block game like Hytale or Vintage Story.

关于 “丑化”资源包是对《我的世界》默认材质进行了修改，使其看起来很丑。每一个《我的世界》材质都经过了一个自定义脚本来丑化材质。 用于创建此资源包的脚本位于以下GitHub资源库中：https://github.com/AndEditor7/UglifierScript 如果你想在运行时自动丑化材质，包括修改过的和资源包，你可以在这里使用这个Minecraft的修改：https://modrinth.com/模组/uglifier 它为什么存在 当你使用了糟糕的材质，然后在玩了一段时间后删除它们时，会出现一种现象，即Minecraft的材质看起来清晰明快。如果你在玩了太多Hytale或Vintage Story这样的高清方块游戏后需要重新调整到Minecraft的默认材质，那么这个方法很有用。

RealLogin

 Login plugin with PIN & GUI interaction 

A lightweight login plugin where players type a PIN on a keypad instead of a password in chat.

 Discord Source Code Report a Bug 

 

---

 What is RealLogin?

 RealLogin asks every player for a PIN when they join. New players pick a PIN on a keypad GUI, and returning players click their PIN in to log in. Until they do, they can't move, chat or use commands, and closing the keypad just opens it again.

 Features

- PIN keypad GUI for registering and logging in, with number heads or plain panes
- PINs are stored hashed (salted PBKDF2), never as plain text
- Sessions : a player who rejoins shortly after logging in doesn't need to type the PIN again
- PIN reset : players can reset their own PIN, and admins can delete anyone's
- Admin bypass to let a waiting player in without their PIN
- Login history : the date and IP of each join, show
